<?php
class ScopeBase240 { public function capture($value) { echo self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return $value; } }
class Scope240 extends ScopeBase240 { public static function launch() { global $owner; $owner->MiSsInG(([new self,"capture"])(true)); $owner->MiSsInG(([new parent,"capture"])(true)); $owner->MiSsInG(first:([new static,"capture"])(true)); } } class ScopeChild240 extends Scope240 { public function capture($value) { echo "CHILD/",static::class,";"; return $value; } }
class ScopeMagic240 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } }
$owner = new ScopeMagic240; ScopeChild240::launch(); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
function shift240() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class PacketBase240 { public $saved = 0; public function __construct($value) { $this->saved = $value; echo "CTOR;"; } public function capture($first,$ignored) { echo "CAPTURE;"; return $this; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketScope240 extends PacketBase240 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(([new static(7),"capture"])(true,shift240())); } } class PacketChild240 extends PacketScope240 {}
class Owner240 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new Owner240; $child = PacketChild240::launch(); echo "RETURN;"; echo ($child->saved[0] instanceof PacketChild240 && $child->saved[0]->saved === 7) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class StopBase240 { public function capture() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "CAPTURE;"; throw new Exception("stop"); } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class StopScope240 extends StopBase240 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(([new parent,"capture"])(),later240()); } } class StopChild240 extends StopScope240 {}
function later240() { echo "LATER;"; return 1; } class FailedMagic240 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new FailedMagic240; $result = 0; try { $result = StopChild240::launch(); } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CATCH;"; } echo $result === 0 ? "HELD;" : "BAD;";
